messages.content: You are a helpful assistant that rewrites MS C++ code into functionally equivalent variants. The code reads and writes I/O from the console.

samples.content:
<original_code>
#include<iostream>
#include <string>
#include <algorithm>
#include <cmath>
#include <iomanip>
#include <map>
#include <queue>
#include<set>
#include<stack>
using namespace std;

int main(){
    long long x, y, n;
    cin >> x >> y >> n;
    int bestx=0, besty=1;
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++)
    {
        long long temp = (x*i) / y;
        if (x*i - temp*y > (temp + 1)*y - x*i) temp += 1;
        if (abs(besty*(x*i - temp*y)) < abs(i*(x*besty - y*bestx)))
        {
            bestx = temp;
            besty = i;
        }
    }
    cout << bestx << "/" << besty << endl;
    return 0;
}
</original_code>
